source: PC thermometer: the level's angrytime=240 in the PC data (level_laundry/level.xml, 1/20 s ticks) is the 12.0 s the mercury takes to drain from full — tools/pcref/thermo.py measured the same off the video; PCThermometerDrain 8.33 %/s is the HUD's drawing rate only, the tick meter keeps the mobile data's AngryMeterDecay (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7). PC data (level_laundry/tricks.xml): vacuum_hole 13, clothes_food 12, electrotrap 7 against the mobile's Vacuum 15, Airer 13, ElectricTrap 11 — 79 for the eight, so the PC's 100 takes all seven ticks (Badinfos' E11: 8/8, 7).   Badinfos' E11 pays the ironing board 26 s after the drier, at the neighbour's FIRST ironing of the lap (his popups: 7, 10, 10, 10 at 222, 7, 13, 10, 12): on PC the board is armed between his second ironing and the next lap's first; the mobile's hot iron starts cold and his first ironing heats it, so the port could only arm it between his two ironings and pay at the second — Primed true at the start puts the toggle in the PC's phase. PC per-trick angrytime (tricks.xml: marbles 300, vacuum_hole 300, tumbledrier_smashed 270; 1/20 s): the anger indicator holds at its maximum that long after the trick — the thermometer's long holds on the video (E14's marbles 18.1 s, E09's 12.6, E05's 14.6) — carried as PCAngryTime for the profile's hold (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7). Level_Laundry::run in game.exe (docs/PC_ROUTINES.md): the washer runs two wash cycles (give, wash, get_clothes twice) and the drier two dry cycles where the mobile's ActionManager lists three WashingMachine and three Drier entries — the PC lap keeps two of each.
